desc: Ideate approach: binary search answer and solve fixed-L feasibility with a small automaton/DP.
Implement can(L) DP: initialize first character, transition to same bit only if run length < L and to opposite bit with run length 1, add flip cost, cap at numOps+1, and return min cost <= numOps.
Implement binary search over L using can(L), with high set to the original maximum run length (or n) and low = 1.
Run sample tests and edge cases, plus random small-n brute-force validation; fix any failures.
